business_summary: TATA Health International Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the wholesale and retail of footwear products in Hong Kong, and Macau. The company operates through Trading of Footwear Products, Trading of Healthcare Products, Financial Services, and Online Medical Services segments. The company was formerly known as S. Culture International Holdings Limited and changed its name to TATA Health International Holdings Limited in November 2020. TATA Health International Holdings Limited was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Kwai Chung, Hong Kong. TATA Health International Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Shang Ying Financial Holding Co., Limited.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 TATA Health International Holdings Limited는 홍콩과 마카오에서 신발 제품의 도매 및 소매업에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 신발 제품 거래, 의료 제품 거래, 금융 서비스 및 온라인 의료 서비스 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 이전에 S. Culture International Holdings Limited로 알려졌으며 2020년 11월에 TATA Health International Holdings Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. TATA Health International Holdings Limited는 2013년에 법인화되었으며 홍콩 콰이청에 본사를 두고 있습니다. TATA Health International Holdings Limited는 Shang Ying Financial Holding Co., Limited의 자회사입니다.
